units: Erub. 83ᵃ כמה ו׳ how much is that ‘and something’?—Pl. וְעוֹדוֹת additions.
<cite ref="Eruvin 83a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אייתי ו׳ דרבי וכ׳</he> bring along the additions which Rabbi speaks of, and add them thereto.
<cite ref="Eruvin 83a:2">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>בו׳ דרבי</he> Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. <he>ועודיות של רבי</he>, corr. acc.).
